title.zh: 第一件真实乐器能出声了
title.en: The first real instrument can sound

highlights.zh: SFZ 引擎学会了 #define 变量（键与值都插值）与 default_path，于是真实的采样乐器不再静音。
highlights.en: The SFZ engine learned #define variables in keys as well as values, and default_path, so real sampled instruments are no longer silent.

highlights.zh: 萨拉曼德大钢琴已镜像到 R2：668 个文件、641 段时长实测，公网可达且字节相符。
highlights.en: Salamander Grand Piano is mirrored to R2: 668 files, 641 durations measured, publicly reachable with bytes matching.

highlights.zh: 镜像从此有脚本：清单生成器、预算检查、上传与可达性核对。
highlights.en: Mirroring now has scripts: a manifest builder, a budget check, an uploader and a reachability check.

title.zh: 顶部导航加了新建入口
title.en: A New entry in the top navigation

highlights.zh: 顶部导航里多了一个新建，直接进入新编排 /new。
highlights.en: The top navigation now has a New entry that opens the new arrangement at /new.

highlights.zh: 它是一个链接而不是标签页：新项目是一条自己的路由，不必成为第十四个导航词。
highlights.en: It is a link rather than a tab: a new project is a route of its own and need not become a fourteenth nav word.

highlights.zh: 手机底部导航的入口还在做。
highlights.en: The mobile bottom bar entry is still to come.

title.zh: 新编排界面用上了应用的样式
title.en: The new arrangement interface uses the app's styling

highlights.zh: 此前的 /new 是一堆没有样式的文字：组件一个类都没用，而应用是用工具类与设计令牌画的。
highlights.en: Until now /new was a wall of unstyled text: the components used no classes, while the app is drawn with utilities and tokens.

highlights.zh: 现在卡片、轨道行、take 选择器、录音按钮都使用应用已有的词汇，不新造一套。
highlights.en: Cards, track rows, the take selector and the record button now use the app's existing vocabulary rather than a new one.

highlights.zh: 而原有三层检查都是绿的，所以还补一个「新组件必须用到样式」的检查。
highlights.en: All three existing checks were green, so a check of the missing kind is added: a new component must use styling.

title.zh: 新轨道一出生就有内容
title.en: A new track arrives with content

highlights.zh: 新建轨道带一段符合类型的节奏；采样器轨还带着示例库的资产。
highlights.en: A new track arrives with a pattern suited to its kind, and a sampler track also carries the sample library's asset.

highlights.zh: 编排自己保存音符（notesByTrack）；删除轨道时音符一起走。
highlights.en: The arrangement keeps its own notes, and a deleted track takes its notes with it.

highlights.zh: 因此 /new 里按 Play 会真的规划出事件，而采样器轨道会出声。
highlights.en: So pressing Play in /new plans real events, and a sampler track sounds.

highlights.zh: 在 /new 里按 Play：编排被编译成引擎的车道，交给应用自己的音频引擎。
highlights.en: Press Play in /new: the arrangement is compiled into engine lanes and handed to the app's own audio engine.

highlights.zh: 采样器轨道因此真的会出声——这条路以前没有判据。
highlights.en: A sampler track therefore actually sounds — a path that had no criterion before.

highlights.zh: 引擎还没就绪时，按钮说明原因并显示规划出的事件数（含 0），而不是静默。
highlights.en: When the engine is not ready the button says so and shows the planned event count, including zero, rather than going silent.

title.en: /new opens on the chooser, then the arrangement

highlights.zh: 打开 /new 先看到模板卡片：鼓+贝斯、鼓+贝斯+和声、两条采样器，以及空白。
highlights.en: Opening /new shows template cards: drums+bass, drums+bass+chords, two samplers, and blank.

highlights.zh: 每张卡上有一句人话说明它给你什么；Details 折叠着 Tempo 与调性。
highlights.en: Each card carries one sentence saying what it gives you, with tempo and key folded into Details.

highlights.zh: 空白卡带一条默认轨道，类型就在这里选；选中哪张卡，造出来的就是哪张。
highlights.en: The blank card carries one default track whose kind you choose here, and the created project is the highlighted card.

title.en: A track's kind can be changed at any time

highlights.zh: 每条轨道头上多了一个类型下拉：改成采样器轨道，就能测采样与录音。
highlights.en: Every track row has a kind selector: switch one to a sampler to test sampling and recording.

highlights.zh: 改类型时，属于音源的字段被丢掉，属于内容的被保留——录过的东西还在。
highlights.en: Changing the kind drops what belonged to the sound source and keeps what is content, so what was recorded stays.

highlights.zh: 新编排仍在 /new：默认一条轨道，可增删、静音独奏、改名、折叠与分组。
highlights.en: The new arrangement is still at /new: one track to start, with add, delete, mute, solo, rename, fold and grouping.

title.en: The new arrangement has an entrance: /new

highlights.zh: 打开 /new 进入新编排：默认带一条轨道，类型由新建时选择。
highlights.en: Open /new for the new arrangement: one track to start, typed by what you choose when creating.

highlights.zh: 这条路由刻意不带曲风——其它路由都退回默认曲风，它是第一个例外。
highlights.en: This route deliberately carries no genre; every other route falls back to a default, and it is the first exception.

highlights.zh: 模板三种：鼓+贝斯、鼓+贝斯+和声、两条采样器；也可以空白。
highlights.en: Three templates — drums+bass, drums+bass+chords, two samplers — plus blank.

highlights.zh: 录音与采样：按下录一段、或选采样器轨道，就是能听到的那两种。
highlights.en: Recording and sampling: press record or choose a sampler track — the two kinds that can be heard.

title.zh: 编排 v2：任意轨道、takes 与录音
title.en: Arrangement v2: arbitrary tracks, takes and recording

highlights.zh: 新编排模型：任意轨道、文件夹收纳、增删与静音独奏；旧歌只读投影，逐字段比对。
highlights.en: A new arrangement model: arbitrary tracks, folder grouping, add and delete, mute and solo; old songs are projected read-only and compared field by field.

highlights.zh: 录音：takes 与 comp 是同一机制的两用，字节只存本机（IndexedDB/OPFS）。
highlights.en: Recording: takes and comping are one mechanism used twice, with the bytes kept on the device (IndexedDB/OPFS).

highlights.zh: 界面：轨道列表、take 选择器、录一段；三块共用同一份编排。
highlights.en: Interface: a track list, a take selector and a record button, all three reading one arrangement.

highlights.zh: 无麦克风时的拒绝具名且可读，并有 CI 判据守着。
highlights.en: A missing microphone is refused by name with a readable sentence, guarded by a CI criterion.

title.zh: 真实采样乐器：SFZ、R2 镜像与清单
title.en: Real sampled instruments: SFZ support, an R2 mirror and a manifest

highlights.zh: SFZ 子集解析器：include、变量、按 region 继承、`<master>`；与 sfizz 逐音符对照。
highlights.en: An SFZ subset parser — includes, variables, per-region inheritance, `<master>` — verified note by note against sfizz.

highlights.zh: 清单随仓库发布：1659 个采样带哈希与体积，实测最长 14.53 秒；字节镜像到 R2。
highlights.en: A manifest shipped in the repository: 1659 samples with hashes and sizes, longest measured at 14.53 s; the bytes mirrored to R2.

highlights.zh: 采样地址源优先，源不可用才回退镜像，两个都失败时两个地址都被点名。
highlights.en: Sample addresses are source-first, falling back to the mirror, and both are named when both fail.

highlights.zh: 音频车道首次接入播放：编排播放会规划、加载并落位采样。
highlights.en: Audio lanes are wired into playback for the first time: arrangement playback plans, loads and places their samples.
